title: Self-Evolving Agents Can Repair Failures but Struggle to Generalize from Them
abstract: arXiv:2610.22984v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Experience-driven self-evolution offers a promising path for large language model (LLM) agents to continually improve through interaction. Yet existing approaches often rely on successful trajectories or external evaluation signals, leaving unclear whether agents can evolve when such positive anchors are unavailable. We study this question through Cold-Start Failure-Only Evolution (CFOE), where agents start without accumulated experience and learn only from failed interactions without privileged guidance. Across three self-evolving paradigms, multiple LLM backbones, and four interactive environments, we uncover a consistent repair-generalization gap: failure-derived experience can help repair previously failed tasks, but rarely yields sustained improvements on unseen tasks. translated_title: 自我进化智能体能够修复失败，但难以从失败中泛化
translated_abstract: 经验驱动的自我进化为大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过交互持续改进提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，现有方法通常依赖成功的轨迹或外部评估信号，因此当这些正面锚点不可用时，智能体能否实现进化尚不清楚。我们通过“冷启动仅失败进化”（CFOE）来研究这一问题，即智能体在没有任何积累经验的情况下开始，仅从失败的交互中学习，且没有特权指导。跨越三种自我进化范式、多个LLM骨干模型和四个交互环境的实验，我们揭示了一个一致的“修复-泛化差距”：从失败中获取的经验可以帮助修复之前失败的任务，但很少能在未见过的任务上带来持续的改进。进一步分析表明，智能体经常误解失败原因，而即使是经过验证正确的经验也难以迁移。放松CFOE约束后我们发现，验证（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 研究发现，仅从失败经验中学习的自我进化智能体能够修复之前失败的任务，但这种经验难以泛化到未见过的任务上，且智能体常常误解失败原因。
en_tdlr: Self-evolving agents that learn only from failures can repair previously failed tasks but struggle to generalize such experience to unseen tasks, often misinterpreting the causes of failure.
